### Mandatory joint-space phase — 2026-11-23

The founder explicitly required that the original coupled-constraint construction design govern the build, rather than treating each unresolved bank as an independent filling task. The formal build now carries the normative `gse.ssl-construction/2` contract, SSL-01 through SSL-11: reading eligibility before selection; complete applicable constraint closure; learning scoped exclusions and conjunctions; dynamic question selection; typed exception refinement; exact joint-space accounting where supported; whole-corpus frequency buckets; and executable anti-regression obligations. The historical coverage measurements remain intact. They do not retrospectively establish that the complete intended learning controller was exercised. [Formal execution contract](../../../../gse/docs/program/LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md#mandatory-ssl-execution-and-measurement-contract)

For this phase, define $N_t(w)=|\Omega_t(w)|$ as the number of complete 56-bank assignments satisfying the actual admitted constraints for definition $w$. Report $\sigma_{GSE,t}(w)=\log_2 N_t(w)$ and the corpus sum $\sum_w\sigma_{GSE,t}(w)$. This is the declared specification-space complexity of the lexical artifact under fixed evidence, rules and basis; it is distinct from the minimum distinguishing-test quantity $\sigma(P,\mu)$ in the program-specification papers. Disconnected solved components contribute their exhaustive witness counts and free coordinates contribute their remaining domain sizes. The marginal domain-log sum remains an upper bound, not a substitute for the joint count. Solver limits and missing certificates leave exact counts unavailable; conflicts earn no completion credit. This is a count of admissible representations, without an assumed distribution over their semantic correctness.

The first whole-corpus measurement reads active sparse release 021 without changing it. The fixed cohort contains **401,595 lexical definitions over 67,173 normalized spellings**, plus one separately reported sentence construction. It has **410,970 filled banks**, including **280,858 explicit zeros**, and **22,078,350 unresolved banks**. Every lexical definition has complete joint-search receipts. The corpus joint log-space is **32,819,443.22562693 bits**, compared with the marginal-domain upper bound **34,993,356.827796936 bits**. Thus the existing constraints already retain approximately **2,173,913.60217 bits** of coupled exclusions invisible to a marginal-domain-only report. This difference is existing structure, not newly learned information in this phase. Mean unresolved banks per definition are **54.97665558585142**; the spelling-weighted mean of per-sense averages is **54.79586979239802**.

| Spelling-frequency rank | Spellings | Definitions | Mean unresolved banks per definition | Joint specification bits |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1–500 | 500 | 15,028 | 55.23569337237157 | 1,234,737.2729674464 |
| 501–1500 | 1,000 | 25,440 | 55.15420597484277 | 2,086,295.8900746875 |
| 1501–5000 | 3,500 | 56,654 | 55.08871394782363 | 4,639,420.523559095 |
| 5001+ | 20,402 | 132,300 | 54.986439909297054 | 10,812,827.752946159 |
| Absent/zero frequency | 41,771 | 172,173 | 54.88341958379072 | 14,046,161.78607954 |

These buckets rank corpus spellings by positive local SUBTLEX count with a spelling tie-break, retaining every sense. They do not estimate the usage frequency of each sense. The frequency bytes hash to `fa636292ba0b1b5cf4d6d335690ddcf3a162e4a8204124d95c64e795eb336226`; the complete definition-cohort hash is `0fb31598c9368cc974eefa4787da39058eacfad571c1df7e823ba37efb8b63f7`. [Complete baseline measurement](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-space-021.json)

Implementation verification includes a synthetic 9→3 joint reduction with unchanged marginal domains and a 3→2 narrowing that settles no bank. The controller consumes joint-space gain, each legal answer's closure and the full declared hypothesis portfolio's leave-one-rule-out reach; pairwise bridge diagnostics remain explanatory detail. A three-rule-chain test reverses the priority a two-rule look-ahead would choose. The proposal/audit path accepts one- or two-valued consequences. An end-to-end synthetic exclusion test teaches, independently audits, admits and fully replays a rule that fills zero new banks but reduces joint specification complexity. Its audit model supplies both permitted values on separate held-out definitions, and its questions retain the original unconstrained answer schema. The focused verification receipt records **294 passing tests**, zero failures and zero errors; those are mechanical tests, not independent linguistic observations. [Executable verification receipt](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-implementation-verification.json)

The opening candidate also has a separately measured comparison with active 021: **115 net additional filled banks** and **111.07685915753245 bits** of joint-space contraction. These changes belong to the earlier 022 rules and native reference-proof integration, including model-prefix retirement; they are not new semantic learning in this phase. [Candidate opening measurement](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-space-candidate-baseline.json)

The first real population round investigates nondeictic physical naming under the approved I/YOU reference-only boundary. Its exact native guard identifies **25,263 definitions**. The teaching frontier explicitly names ordinary water, body and rock senses before frequency orders them; disjoint audits span animals, plants, artifacts and matter. The scope does not claim all nouns are nondeictic and reserves person/address/pronominal readings. Individual and joint forecasts precede admission; actual semantic outcomes and full-corpus replay will be appended when complete. The pending candidate remains unpublished. Namespace-only comparison defects found during preflight are repaired without rewriting historical source observations or request identities; full replay still determines acceptance. [Semantic warrant](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-reference-warrant.md) · [Frozen phase plan](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-reference-plan.json)

The completed read-only population stage forecasts **25,263 new singleton banks per rule**, or **50,526 jointly**, with no formal contradictions. Each isolated rule contributes **32,343.329472126086 bits** against its source-only post-retirement baseline; their joint contribution is **63,229.34262338057 bits**. The overlap is **1,457.3163208715996 bits**, so adding the two isolated gains would overstate contraction. Six old model-filled cells would reopen under the existing context-retirement policy: BODY and WANT for the iodine sense under “i”; BODY for Indiana and indium under “in”; and BODY and WANT for Maine under “me.” Their original receipts remain audit evidence. No new zero is supplied for those reopened banks. These are provisional consequences of unadmitted hypotheses, with **zero model questions and zero bank writes in the staging operation**; they are not yet observed semantic learning or a publication result. [Complete staged changes and joint counts](../../../../gse/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-reference-stage.json)

#### Engineering reconciliation and checkpoint acceptance — 2026-11-23

The complete reread of the SSL skeleton reinforces a distinction in the experimental claim:
§2.5 predicts exponential decay of remaining H in the bulk when structural amplification is
proportional to H. The identity that a bit halves a configuration count does not establish that
learning dynamic. The trajectory, direct teaching cost and additional structural effects must be
measured across rounds. Minimum teaching evidence and the artifact's log feasible-count measure
also retain their distinct definitions.

The engineering audit found that the general workflow already describes discovery/refinement
feedback, but several production consumers do not yet complete it. `run_arm` freezes the candidate
families at initialization and exports newly mined chains at finalization; `run_epoch` withholds
audit disagreements without invoking a refinement cycle. The public equal-budget comparator still
chooses acceptance from singleton/interaction counts despite the new phase joint-space reports.
Its storage/resume scheme also retains whole teaching and candidate DBs for each epoch until
publication. These are specific integration gaps, not absence of the existing solver, source,
refinement, revision or publication mechanisms.

A fresh public encoder probe reproduces an acceptance-critical wrong identity: both “He went
home.” and “The chemical symbol He denotes helium.” select the closed-class pronoun record. The
second case shows why parser-role selection must remain subject to contextual reading eligibility.
This is a two-case runtime finding, not a corpus accuracy estimate.
[Identity probe](../../../../GSE/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-checkpoint-identity-probe.json)

The saved full candidate preflight validates all 401,596 entries with complete joint search but
still fails catalogue metadata. The attempted catalogue refresh also refused that mismatch. The
saved full repository test report has 45 `UNKNOWN_BANK:YOU` failures in two reduced-basis fixture
modules. They remain failed/pending gates until repaired and rerun; the earlier 294 focused passes
do not replace them. The active pointer still names 021. One water/I question has a journaled
model answer, pending the validated writer; the staged population laws remain unadmitted.

The existing GSE-01 specification and OpenSpec change now share one
[engineering sequence, CP-01–CP-08](../../../../GSE/docs/program/LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md#engineering-execution-one-checkpoint-and-a-continuing-learner):
restore the baseline; connect discovery and surprise work; close refinement and joint revision;
recompute interacting question priorities; consume joint measurements in comparison; bound working
storage and resume; enforce runtime identity and a declared workload gate; then publish and
continue the same learner. The older 58-coordinate constructor remains explicitly distinct from
the active 56-ordinary-bank state; no authored-silence conversion supplies new zeros.

The [engineering-audit receipt](../../../../GSE/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-engineering-audit.json)
pins the inspected code and specification files, the failed recorded gates, the fresh identity
probe and the passing strict specification/reference checks. Those checks validate the engineering
documents, not the unimplemented feedback or a new lexical release.

The usable checkpoint must retain the already specified 90% eligible token-mass cohort in both
frequency and independent text sources, with genre slices, and pass the promised operations'
required bank/structure outcomes. That percentage is not an allowed semantic error rate.
Recognition or a small finite runtime probe set is insufficient. Development benchmarks used to
guide teaching are no longer untouched final holdouts. Full replay, independent two-sided audits,
critical runtime outcomes and applicable repository checks precede atomic sparse activation.
The candidate retains every unresolved tail definition; checkpoint usability is distinct from
whole-lexicon completion. This documentation audit writes no lexical assignments and records no
new admitted rule or learning-curve result.

#### Controller implementation follow-up — 2026-11-23

The catalogue repair has now been applied to the working candidate through the existing
catalogue operation. Its full repair replay validated 401,596 entries. The subsequent measurement
retains 401,595 lexical definitions, with the sentence-only duration construction accounted for
separately: 411,085 filled banks, 22,078,235 unresolved banks and exact joint specification size
32,819,332.148767773 bits. Every frequency bucket has zero change in filled banks and joint bits
against the pre-repair working baseline. This was a metadata repair, not new linguistic learning.
The ordinary post-repair replay subsequently passed: 401,596 entries, zero mismatches,
2,495,950 joint components and no solver limits. Semantic gold was not checked by that replay.

The controller now has a versioned open-bank curriculum separate from rule hypotheses, a compact
transactional hypothesis/review ledger, and a review intake that does not replace the frozen
plan. A legal teaching disagreement is retained through the ordinary typed writer; a null answer
remains unknown. Discovered conditions require a warrant and independent audit before admission.
The earlier expanded integration run passed 166 tests. A subsequent six-test run passed the
public entry-point path and a complete synthetic contrast cycle using the actual Regenesis guard
imputer: retain an audit counterexample, propose a distinguishing native condition, review it,
use fresh audit senses, admit only the narrowed law and replay the fixture population. The
negative sense remains unknown rather than inheriting the rejected parent's sign or a zero.
These are mechanism tests on labelled synthetic data, not an NSM research result or a new
population law for English.

The comparison consumer now uses actual phase joint-space measurements and retains singleton
counts separately. Further intake tests require an invalid batch to leave the durable review
queue unchanged, prevent stale reviews from reviving rejected hypotheses, and keep the reserved
audit pool out of teaching. Two intermediate 172-test runs retained one fixture failure: first
an out-of-competence native QUANTITY claim, then an unlinked authored assertion. Neither
production guard was relaxed. The corrected fixture establishes its known coordinate through
an explicitly synthetic manifest law. The final maintained-suite gate passed 7,520 tests with
zero failures/errors and 66 skips, including the actual guard-imputer integration. Whole-project
ty reported 216 advisory diagnostics; the changed controller files passed their scoped type
check. These are software verification results, not linguistic accuracy measurements.

The catalogue-only rebase is now pinned explicitly, retaining the original plan. Rebuilding the
water/I question produces the same request ID, schema and pinned transport identity as its
original journal; its answer can be reused without another model call. It remains uncommitted
until the writer stage. [Rebase receipt](../../../../GSE/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json)

The storage/writer trace identified another concrete consumer obligation: each per-question
`teach` call invokes a fresh full-corpus completion preflight. The existing sustained writer

challenges, joint revisions, crash recovery, the contextual identity repair and the independent
usable-workload gate remain open. The active release is still 021; the I/YOU population stage
remains unadmitted. No new linguistic rule or publication is claimed for this implementation
stage. [Controller verification receipt](../../../../GSE/docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-controller-verification.json)

#### Checkpoint-first execution and durable controller evidence — 2026-11-24

Rohan's direct deadline now prioritizes a usable checkpoint before finishing the
general learning-controller research. Unknown remains unknown, and the existing
source, independent semantic, full replay, runtime and declared-workload gates
remain binding. Sparse activation and whole-lexicon completion remain distinct.

The controller's new owned-scope verification passes **1,800 tests with zero
skips, failures or errors**, including the actual Regenesis guard imputer. The
writer accepts bounded explicit entry–bank tuples on its existing sustained,
validated connection without asking the Cartesian product of those entries and
banks. A durable head transition installs an epoch and its content-addressed
outcome atomically. Resume no longer needs every historical phase database;
owned-stage retirement preserves complete native streams and every unique audit
delta before unlinking. Connected synthetic tests interrupt teaching-result,
migration-result, pre/post head CAS and post-unlink boundaries, actually remove
old databases, and retain the accepted questions without repeating them. Explicit
reviewed joint revisions use ordinary migration; unsupported conclusions reopen
while independent support survives. A rule warrant cannot silently review an
earlier model-answer prefix. These are software-mechanism results, not new
English bank laws or corpus contractions. Publication-interruption recovery and
the complete generic surprise/joint-tuple language remain open.

The real reference-scope census finds **25,263 definitions**, with **six active
model receipts across four definitions**. Their full chains must be retained and
reconsidered under migration rather than quietly treated as independent native
proofs. The eight prepared teaching/audit questions preserve exact wire fields,
schema and transport. Replaying the original water/I reply through typed
admission **in memory** yields ASSIGNED; stale-context and wrong-bank adversarial

For that single definition the exact in-memory joint contraction is
